paragraphs: Rabbi Chaga, in Rabbi Yose’s name: Bava Batra 19, beginning of side b, and 25b. He asked Rabbi Yose: Berakhot; Terumot 2:1; chapter Hazorek, halakhah 3. Rabbi Yosa in Yaavetz’s name. In Rabbi Pedat’s name: chapter Hearel. Rabbi Chaga in Ulla’s name: Gittin 23a. Rav Chaga objected to Ulla, who told him, “He does not know what the rabbis say and raises an objection!” Avodah Zarah 68a. Ein Yaakov there and Yalkut Psalms, end of section 93, have Chaggai. Rabbi Chaga went up the steps of Rabbah bar Sheila’s house: Chelek 111, beginning of side b. Rabbi Chaga reported Rabbi Hoshaya: Keritot 28a. He reported Rabbi Yoshiyah: Yoma 41, end of side a; there, side b, Rabbi Hoshaya. Keritot and Yoma are all one matter.
